title: tragacantha altaica
intro: Tragacantha altaica, commonly known as Altai milkvetch, is a perennial plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The health benefits of Tragacantha altaica include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate respiratory problems, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
